title: CIbSE 2027
level: Researchers and doctoral students (open call for papers)
about: CIbSE 2027, part of the Ibero-American Software Engineering Week (SIbSE 2027) organised by Universidad Andrés Bello, takes place 10 to 14 May 2027 in Viña del Mar, Chile. Main-track abstracts are due 11 January 2027 and full papers 18 January 2027, via EasyChair.

upskill.name: AI Automation for DevOps & Software Engineering
why: field "Software engineering" -> objective "Apply AI across CI/CD pipelines, technical documentation, code review, issue management, monitoring, incident response, and other software engineering operations."

seniority "Researchers and doctoral students (open call for papers)" -> objective "Analyze logs, system behavior, operational metrics, alerts, and technical evidence with AI to accelerate troubleshooting and incident investigation."

card_alt: Card for CIbSE 2027, the Ibero-American Conference on Software Engineering (CIbSE), in Viña del Mar, Chile; abstract deadline 11 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Plaza de Armas and Metropolitan Cathedral in Santiago, Chile, not Viña del Mar.
